'''International relations'''
*[[United Kingdom–European Union relations]]
**[[Northern Ireland Protocol]]
***[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]] and [[President of the European Commission|European Commission President]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] announce the [[United Kingdom]] and [[European Union]] had reached an [[Windsor Framework|agreement]] on [[Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union|post-Brexit]] trade arrangements for [[Northern Ireland]] after a protracted row over the [[Northern Ireland Protocol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-eu-leaders-meet-monday-finalise-northern-ireland-deal-2023-02-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Egypt–Syria relations]], [[Egypt–Turkey relations]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Egypt)|Egyptian foreign minister]] [[Sameh Shoukry]] visits [[Syria]] and [[Turkey]] in the first official state visit by [[Egypt]] in more than 10 years amid strained relations with both countries. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230226-egypt-fm-to-head-to-turkey-syria-for-first-time-in-decade (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Disappearance of Constance Marten and Mark Gordon]]
**Constance Marten and Mark Gordon are found and arrested in [[Hollingbury]], [[Brighton]], [[England]], after they went missing with their newborn baby on 5 January. They were found without their baby, which triggered a huge search involving over 200 police officers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-64794712 (BBC News)]
